== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Jawa (Dark) (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Jawa (Dark) (Premiere)]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/jawa__darkside_japanese_white_border/50614 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/3d9cb6b2b44e4feebe3414b9deba2d7c/IMG_20220607_0121.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(48, 10, 816, 1050)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>dfcba4c26b44c97faf13b81e385aab7daf41a14fab75d1ea0ce14c8953513cf4</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
